 What to Stream 10 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Nov 2-8): The Remarried Empress, Love in Disguise, Final Table And More 
 We have 10 new K-drama OTT releases lined up for the week of November 2-8, 2026, and there is plenty to add to your watchlist. We start with The Remarried Empress and Love in Disguise, followed by Final Table, Oh! My Guard, Between Steps, Merry Berry Love, Doctor X: Mafia in White, 100 Days of Deception, Make Me Tingle and kiDnap GAME. These Korean dramas and international series bring a mix of stories to Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Viu and more. The K-drama OTT releases this week, November 2-8, include The Remarried Empress, Love in Disguise, Final Table, Oh! My Guard, Between Steps, Merry Berry Love, Doctor X: Mafia in White, 100 Days of Deception, Make Me Tingle and kiDnap GAME. The lineup brings royal intrigue, romance, suspense, medical drama and culinary competition to streaming platforms such as Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Viu and Viki.  Korean dramas are not only rivetting they also bring forth refreshing social angles that are infrequently explored. And that is the road we are heading towards in this list. A palace divorce, a detective hiding behind a disguise, a chef chasing culinary glory and a spy caught between secrets and romance. Well, K-dramas know how to keep things interesting, and this week has a little of everything. The new K-drama OTT releases this week (November 2-8) bring 10 titles to your watchlist, starting with Shin Min-a's The Remarried Empress and Love in Disguise. There is also Final Table, Oh! My Guard, Between Steps and Merry Berry Love, while Doctor X: Mafia in White and 100 Days of Deception bring their share of suspense. Rounding off the week are Make Me Tingle and kiDnap GAME. Check out all 10 K-dramas, along with their latest episode dates and streaming platforms.
 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Nov 2-8)
 The Remarried Empress (Disney+): November 3
 The first four episodes premiered on November 3. Shin Min-a plays Empress Navier, whose marriage to Emperor Sovieshu (Ju Ji-hoon) ends when he takes Rashta (Lee Se-young) as his mistress. Her response to his divorce demand leads to palace politics and a possible second marriage to Prince Heinrey (Lee Jong-suk).
 Love in Disguise (Prime Video): November 2 and 3
 Yim Si-wan and Seol In-ah lead this office romance with a murder mystery at its centre. Episodes 5 and 6 follow detective Kang Jae-hee, who poses as a male secretary to investigate chaebol heir Yoon Yi-jun, the prime suspect in a murder case.
 Final Table (Prime Video): November 7 and 8
 Episodes 5 and 6 follow chef Kang Han (Ahn Hyo-seop) as he competes in The Table: K-Chef 2026, a contest to find South Korea’s leading chef. Hong Hwa-yeon plays Choi Song-yi, who wants to protect her late father’s restaurant.
 Oh! My Guard (Viu): November 7 and 8
 Jung Yong-hwa and Hong Seung-hee return in episodes 5 and 6 of this romantic comedy . It follows actor Uhm Tae-bong and Oh Hae-ra, a mysterious woman whose connection with him leads to misunderstandings and secrets.
 Between Steps (Disney+): November 2 and 3
 Episodes 9 and 10 continue the story of Park Min-jae (Choo Young-woo), a former swimmer adjusting to life after losing his right leg, and Im Yu-jin (Kim So-hyun), a graduate student looking for a new direction. Their paths meet in a robotics laboratory, where personal ambitions gradually give way to an unexpected connection
 You may also like New OTT Releases This Week (November 2-8): I'm Game, Haiwaan, Dilwali Diwali And More Merry Berry Love (Disney+): November 4
 Ji Chang-wook and Japanese actor Mio Imada star in this Korea-Japan romantic comedy. Episode 5 follows Lee Yu-bin, a Korean spatial designer who starts over on a Japanese island after a career setback and meets strawberry farmer Shirahama Karin.
 Doctor X: Mafia in White (Netflix): November 6 and 7
 Kim Ji-won returns as surgeon Kye Su-jeong. Episodes 9 and 10 continue her fight against corruption and university hospital politics. Lee Jung-eun and Son Hyun-joo also feature.
 100 Days of Deception (Netflix): November 7 and 8
 Set in 1932 Gyeongseong, this historical spy romance follows Ga Gyeong (Kim Yoo-jung), a pickpocket recruited for an undercover mission during Japanese colonial rule. Park Jin-young plays the Korean-born Japanese interpreter she is assigned to. Episodes 9 and 10 stream this week.
 Make Me Tingle (Viki): November 5
 This romantic comedy ends with episodes 9 and 10. Nam Ji-hyun plays marketer Gong Yeon-su, and Kim Jae-yeong plays Dokgo Dal, CEO of an adult-products startup.
 kiDnap GAME (Viu): November 3
 Lee Joon-gi and Japanese actor Kentaro Sakaguchi star in this survival thriller. Episode 5 follows a detective and a surgeon investigating kidnappings across seven Asian cities. The Japanese-led production also involves South Korean and Hong Kong talent.
